Use the named matrix row; do not interpolate from product marketing. No stronger recommendation or exclusion is inferred beyond that fixed row. Evidence: WT dimension high; projected weight moderate, COND high; R2 none_visible, Cetearyl Alcohol r2 + Cetrimonium Chloride r7: LGN pair, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride r5: independent cationic-polymer route. Limit: Formula-only potential at E2; concentration, dose, finished-product efficacy and measured duration are not established. Broad deterministic fit prior; actual user fit also depends on hair, dose and routine. AD-5: only `recommended` thicknesses are written. Emitted: normal, coarse. Not emitted (conditional/neutral/caution): fine — conditional. The LGN plus independent emollient supports the conditioning baseline; additional Guar HPTC film plus separate lubrication clears the permissive two-observation smoothing focus. General would miss the independent alignment-film-plus-lubrication observation. Repair lacks R2; detangling is not C1/C2 detangler-led or low-weight; curl lacks an architectural L5 route; heat styling has no captured pre_heat direction; shine would duplicate smoothing. Evidence: Admissible COND baseline: Cetearyl Alcohol r2/Cetrimonium Chloride r7 LGN plus Coco-Caprylate r4, Additional film: Guar HPTC r5, not needed by that admissible baseline. Limit: Formula-only potential at E2; concentration, dose, finished-product efficacy and measured duration are not established. §9 as amended by the v1.1 overlay (T20) keeps `moisture` (moisture_led): GLYCERIN r3 is a settled humectant above the tail marker and no persistent film (L2 silicone, silicone quat, Polysilicone-29) exists anywhere in the formula, so nothing outranks it. O5: a DH species leads and no film competes -> `moisture`; v1.0 confidence rules unchanged (not a lone-humectant thin architecture: fatty-alcohol + cationic base present) -> moderate. T20 does not change this product's value; it is re-stated on the v1.1 pins. Evidence: T20 re-derivation 2026-10-09 via deriveLeaveInCareDirectionT20, evidence_level: E2, evidence_scope: formula, anchor row: moisture_led, tail marker: PARFUM r6 / SODIUM BENZOATE r9 (plausible on a 25-ingredient list), Directional species above the tail: GLYCERIN r3 (settled humectant). PANTHENOL r10 sits below the marker (subordinate)., Non-directional (demoted) species above the tail: COCO-CAPRYLATE r4 (dry-feel ester), GUAR HYDROXYPROPYLTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r5 (cationic), CETEARYL ALCOHOL r2 (fatty alcohol), CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE r7 and DISTEAROYLETHYL HYDROXYETHYLMONIUM METHOSULFATE r8 (cationics); they feed COND/WT/PERS but never set a direction., Positioning: 'Feuchtigkeit', 'Lockendefinition', bond-repair claims are counter-signals only (§9 constraint 3).. Limit: §9's ceiling caps a formula-only direction at moderate confidence. T20 compares ranks on one list only; it states no percentage, ratio or dose (G4). Single-lane re-derivation (2026-10-09) from the 2026-09-18 frozen formula; not run by two independent sealed lanes (overlay §5). No R2 candidate/tested and no exact-product repair endpoints; repair support is low. Low is a complete answer, not a missing research value. Medium requires qualifying R2; high requires E3+ exact-product leave-on repair evidence. Evidence: Hydrolyzed Moringa Oleifera Seed Extract r11 is plain hydrolysate, not cationised/silane, Panthenol r10 is not R2, Guar HPTC r5 is non-silicone cationic polymer, excluded from R2. Limit: Formula-only potential at E2; concentration, dose, finished-product efficacy and measured duration are not established. The persistent film family is recorded as the typed smoothing input; no humidity resistance is inferred. None/emollient alone would miss the identified film. No independent shine or graded smoothing score is emitted. Evidence: Admissible COND baseline: Cetearyl Alcohol r2/Cetrimonium Chloride r7 LGN plus Coco-Caprylate r4, Additional film: Guar HPTC r5, not needed by that admissible baseline. Limit: Formula-only potential at E2; concentration, dose, finished-product efficacy and measured duration are not established. AD-3a mapping: focus smoothing, care_direction moisture, repair_support_level low, smoothing_route cationic_alignment -> moisture, anti_frizz. Eligibility triples are the ported `expand_leave_in_eligibility` cross-product over the recommended thicknesses; 6 row(s) emitted.
